{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Annihilatordroid.jpg|300px|thumb|[[BLX-5]] with blast shield.]]
A '''blast shield''' was a sheet of [[dura-armor]] shaped to preference and fitted with grips for grasping. It was capable of deflecting fire, [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] energy, and more. The shield, however, was rather heavy and unwieldy.

Smaller blast shields were also equipped to helmets to prevent flak and other debris from blinding the wearer during combat. Helmets with opaque blast shields were commonly used in conjunction with training [[Remote/Legends|remotes]] as part of [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] for the purposes of honing their skills at deflecting blaster bolts using a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Jedi Academy Training Manual">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] wore a helmet with the blast shield lowered in order to deepen his connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] during his lightsaber training.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

The helmet itself was one of the surviving prototypes of a failed specialized blast shield helmet for the [[Ividal Sector Forces]]' [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95]] starfighters, developed during the [[Attack on Ongary IX]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for protection against the flash of [[burrowing plasma charge]]s. It had been accidentally left behind on the ''Millennium Falcon'' by [[Jorn Kulish]], a disgruntled former member of the Sector Forces' [[Foxfire Squadron]], back when the freighter was known as the ''Stellar Envoy''.<ref name="Warfare Author's Cut Part 10">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-10-the-rise-of-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 10: The Rise of the Empire}}</ref>
